originalDsl:
@diagram uml-sequence
Client actor
WebServer participant as "Web Server"
AuthService participant as "Auth Service"
Database participant

msg_1 = Client -#> WebServer as "POST /login (username, password)"
msg_2 = WebServer -#> AuthService as "validateCredentials(username, password)"
msg_3 = AuthService -#> Database as "SELECT user WHERE username = ?"
msg_4 = Database -.-> AuthService as "user record"
msg_5 = AuthService -#> AuthService as "verify password hash"
alt "credentials valid" {
  msg_6 = AuthService -.-> WebServer as "auth token"
  msg_7 = WebServer -.-> Client as "200 OK + session token"
} else "credentials invalid" {
  msg_8 = AuthService -.-> WebServer as "authentication failed"
  msg_9 = WebServer -.-> Client as "401 Unauthorized"
}

injectedDefects.description: replaced closing quote on label "Auth Service" with Unicode look-alike U+201D
